scenario: [LCAP.2.1.5] / [LDIA.3.3.7]: the deferred-setting refusal precedes the constraint check of [LDIA.3.5.1]. The block sets `realtime: true` without `constspace`, which is the `realtime`-requires-`constspace` violation the deferred [LCAP.3.7] describes; the compiler refuses the setting with DS_VALIDATE_REALTIME_DEFERRED, so a compiler that checks constraints first reports DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_CONSTRAINT instead. PATH PINNED: the deferred-setting check in override resolution in `dsc.dialect`, ahead of the constraint check.

    realtime: true

    v: Int mutable
